## Announcements

- Lab 3
  - "1 - unit increase" for categorical variables is WRONG
    - We are comparing the mean IAT score for different categories
  - Still a couple students with factor issues in main variable
    - Make sure to use `fct_relevel` to change the order of the categories
    - Example: `fatal_dep = fatal_dep %>% mutate(Fatalism = fct_relevel(Fatalism, "Low", "Medium", "High"))`
    - Ordering with `as.order` or `ordered` will mess up your regression ([example](https://stats.stackexchange.com/questions/387735/interpreting-the-estimate-of-an-ordered-factor-in-regression))
